must_include: The ATT for treated firms over the first three post-adoption years is defined before the estimator.
Not-yet-treated states are controls and already-treated states are excluded as controls.
The estimate is −1.6 percentage points with a 95% confidence interval of −2.5 to −0.7 against an 18.0% mean.
The p = 0.18 pre-treatment test is interpreted as diagnostic rather than proof.
The one-year anticipation concern, censoring choice, state clustering, and 42 clusters are stated.
must_avoid: Claiming that parallel trends has been proven or accepted because p exceeds 0.05.
Calling the estimand an effect for all firms, states, or horizons.
Replacing the supplied estimator with an unspecified conventional TWFE regression.
Inventing a robustness check, mechanism, policy detail, or citation.
human_review: The design is understandable without relying on an equation.
The identifying assumption sits next to the comparison that requires it.
Magnitude, uncertainty, target population, anticipation, and inference are easy to audit.
